verdict.rationale: Rive's first-party docs describe an official MCP integration that lets you connect the Rive Editor to AI tools. It exposes tools for agent-driven creation of View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes, so the core story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server is delivered. missing for 10: documented setup/connection steps and supported MCP clients, a full tool inventory beyond the 'first set of tools', and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connect the Rive Editor to AI tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
official MCP server documented at https://rive.app/docs/editor/ai/mcp
